note: No passwords, cookies, CSRF tokens, or session IDs are recorded here. Auth followed official Gateway pages and this Gateway's own OpenAPI; no Designer login or renewal API was invented. Artek-MCP is not installed, so there is no 8.3.9 MCP tools/list on this instance.

web_session.entry: GET /data/app/login redirected to this Gateway's official IdP.
web_session.idp: authentication.js posted to /idp/default/authn/next-challenge and /idp/default/authn/submit-challenge/basic, then GET /idp/default/oidc/auth leading to /data/federate/callback/internal.
web_session.session: A webui-sid-* cookie plus GET /data/app/session provided the csrfToken used with X-CSRF-Token on mutative REST calls.

authenticated_openapi.comparison: The official Docker image on this Mac loaded the full official module set, so authenticated OpenAPI had 580 paths / 679 operations versus 389 on the slimmer Linux-extract environment used earlier.

mcp.note: Official 8.3.9 has no Catalyst Agent MCP. Without Artek-MCP, /mcp stays 404 and tools/list cannot be collected on this Gateway.
